prompt.zh-TW: 青苔書店用現金把店裡全部的書賣給一所學校，收到 {{money:e1.price}}。現金流量表已經由系統算好，請填出資產負債表上的現金及約當現金，讓步驟③（勾稽點 C）亮綠燈。
prompt.en: Moss Bookshop sells all its books to a school for {{money:e1.price}} in cash. The statement of cash flows has been worked out for you; fill in cash and cash equivalents on the balance sheet so that step 3 (check C) turns green.

explanation.zh-TW: 步驟③比對的是現金流量表的期末現金與資產負債表的現金。現金流量表的最後一列是 {{money:expected.t2.after}}，資產負債表的現金也必須是 {{money:expected.t1.after}}；兩邊來自同一筆帳，本來就該相等。填的時候記得用期末餘額，不是這筆交易收到的 {{money:e1.price}}。
explanation.en: Step 3 compares closing cash on the statement of cash flows with cash on the balance sheet. The last line of the statement of cash flows is {{money:expected.t2.after}}, so cash on the balance sheet must also be {{money:expected.t1.after}}; both come from the same books and are meant to agree. Fill in the closing balance, not the {{money:e1.price}} received in this one transaction.
